name: Midgard
slug: Midgard is a realm and Arch of Atlas whose keystone Gerk holds, protects, and uses to help make the realm greater.
description: Midgard is one of the realms and Arches of Atlas, associated with a keystone entrusted to a designated keeper. Its keystone is held by Gerk, who is responsible for protecting it, actively using it, and helping make Midgard greater.

log.summary: Gerk chooses and receives the **Midgard keystone**, becoming its new keeper. His responsibilities include protecting the keystone, actively using it, and helping make Midgard greater. This marks a shift from the practices of previous Midgard keepers, who primarily focused on hiding and preserving the keystone rather than actively engaging with its power or improving the realm.
notes: Gerk chooses and receives the Midgard keystone.
Gerk becomes responsible for protecting, actively using, and helping make Midgard greater.
Previous Midgard keepers primarily hid and preserved its keystone.
